original.name: Invasion of Gobakhan
rules: (As a Siege enters, choose an opponent to protect it. You and others can attack it. When it's defeated, exile it, then cast it transformed.)
When {this} enters, look at target opponent's hand. You may exile a nonland card from it. For as long as that card remains exiled, its owner may play it. A spell cast this way costs {2} more to cast.

secondCardFace.name: Lightshield Array
rules: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature that attacked this turn.
Sacrifice {this}: Creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.

bf96c90d-f2a8-49d3-a066-f97b164d03fc.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
